root_cause.summary: Connection-pool exhaustion introduced in deploy v2.3.1.
root_cause.detail: v2.3.1 changed the pool from per-request lease-and-return to per-handler, so pooled connections were never released under load. Active connections saturated the Postgres max (100), causing new queries to fail with 5xx and latency to balloon.
root_cause.diff:
- pool = get_pool()
- with pool.lease() as conn:
-     return handler(conn)
+ conn = pool.acquire()   # never released on the hot path
+ return handler(conn)

fix.label: Roll back checkout-api to v2.3.0 and restore lease-and-return pooling
fix.pr_title: fix(checkout-api): restore connection lease/return to stop pool exhaustion
fix.manifest: kubectl -n sandbox set image deploy/checkout-api app=checkout-api:v2.3.0

timeline.label: Deploy v1.9.0 (new embedding cache) rolled out

root_cause.summary: Unbounded in-memory embedding cache added in v1.9.0.
root_cause.detail: The new embedding cache had no eviction policy or size cap, so memory grew until the 2GB limit triggered repeated OOMKills and a crash loop.
root_cause.diff:
- # (no cache)
+ CACHE = {}          # unbounded, no TTL / max size
+ CACHE[key] = embed(text)

fix.label: Cap cache at 10k entries with LRU eviction + raise limit to 3Gi
fix.pr_title: fix(reco-svc): bound embedding cache with LRU to stop OOMKill loop
